decisions.reason: A hearty bread loaf builds directly on the bakery's core baking knowledge, so the firm can read early sales signals and refine the recipe with existing know-how.

The historic mill tour sits outside the firm's core food-production knowledge, but it draws on the firm's own milling heritage and adds brand value at low cost, so management keeps it while it learns how visitors respond.
A sweet pastry uses the same dough and baking competencies the firm already holds, which lets it absorb customer feedback and adjust quickly.
